name: Tines
what_they_do: No-code security automation and workflow platform — orchestrates SOC playbooks across SIEM/EDR/ticketing without writing code.
notes: Irish unicorn-trajectory cybersecurity company. Engineering hub in Dublin. Hires AppSec + SOC engineering roles regularly. CSEP-friendly. Strong eng brand.

name: Vaultree
what_they_do: Encryption-in-use (fully homomorphic) — search and operate on encrypted data without decrypting.
notes: Award-winning Cork-based crypto startup (CES Innovation Award). Research-leaning engineering culture. Sponsors strong technical hires.

name: Edgescan
what_they_do: Continuous vulnerability management — full-stack assessment platform with human-validated findings.
notes: One of Ireland's most established AppSec specialists. Annual Vulnerability Stats Report is a go-to industry reference. Hires Pentesters + AppSec engineers consistently. Strong CSEP track record.

name: TitanHQ
what_they_do: Email security, web filtering, archiving — SaaS security for SMBs and MSPs.
notes: Galway-headquartered email security veteran. SOC + product security + threat research roles. Sponsors EU + non-EU hires. Strong west-coast Ireland presence.

name: Smarttech247
what_they_do: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) + SOC-as-a-service for enterprise clients.
notes: Listed MDR provider with significant SOC operations in Cork + Dublin. Hires L1/L2/L3 SOC analysts continuously — strong fit for entry-associate level.

name: Integrity360
what_they_do: Managed security services (MSSP) + cybersecurity consulting across EMEA. Owned by August Equity.
notes: Largest pure-play cybersecurity company in Ireland. Broad role spread — SOC, pentesting, GRC, IR. Sponsors regularly. Excellent first-job destination in Irish cyber.

name: Ekco
what_they_do: Cloud + managed security services — SOC, cloud security posture, business continuity, vCISO.
notes: Fast-growing Irish managed security provider. Cloud security + SOC heavy. Frequent grad + entry-level hires. CSEP eligible roles.

name: Threatscape
what_they_do: Microsoft cybersecurity specialist — Defender, Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview deployments.
notes: Microsoft Security Solutions Partner of the Year (multiple). Hires Microsoft Security engineers (Sentinel, Defender XDR) for SOC + consulting roles.

name: VigiTrust
what_they_do: Integrated risk management (IRM) + cybersecurity awareness training platform.
notes: Small but established Irish GRC platform. Strong focus on PCI DSS + cybersecurity awareness. Smaller hiring volume — verify sponsor status per role.

name: BH Consulting
what_they_do: Boutique cybersecurity + privacy consulting — DPO services, vCISO, incident response, GDPR, ISO 27001.
notes: Founded by Brian Honan (renowned Irish security expert). High-prestige consulting brand. Smaller hiring footprint but excellent GRC + privacy track record.

name: Sysnet Global Solutions
what_they_do: PCI DSS compliance + cybersecurity advisory for the payments industry.
notes: Long-established Irish PCI specialist. Now part of NCC Group. Hires QSAs, GRC analysts, compliance consultants. Sponsor-aware via NCC.

name: Enea AdaptiveMobile Security
what_they_do: Mobile network security — protects mobile operators from signaling attacks, SMS fraud, malware.
notes: Dublin-headquartered telecom security veteran (acquired by Enea 2021). Strong fit if you have Cubic Telecom telematics background — telco security overlap is direct.

name: Trustworks
what_they_do: Boutique cybersecurity advisory — GRC, ISO 27001 implementation, vCISO.
notes: Small but reputable Irish GRC consultancy. ISO 27001 specialism. Limited hiring but strong if you want GRC depth in a boutique setting.

name: ZeroDayLab (Ireland)
what_they_do: Offensive security services — pentesting, red team, threat intelligence.
notes: UK-headquartered offensive security firm with Dublin office. Hires Pentesters + Red Team consultants. Good entry-to-associate pathway via consultant track.

name: Renaissance Security Distribution
what_they_do: Security technology distributor for Ireland — pre-sales, technical enablement, partner support.
notes: Ireland's main security tech distributor. Pre-sales + technical roles available. Useful pivot into vendor-side security careers.

name: DataSolutions
what_they_do: Cybersecurity distributor + value-added reseller (Check Point, Forcepoint, others).
notes: Long-standing Irish security distributor. Acquired by Climb Channel Solutions. Pre-sales + technical channel roles in Dublin.

name: Trend Micro (Cork)
what_they_do: Global cybersecurity vendor with major R&D + EMEA HQ in Cork.
notes: Trend Micro's EMEA hub. Hires threat researchers, SOC, security engineers in Cork. Strong sponsor track record.

name: Mastercard Cyber & Intelligence (Dublin)
what_they_do: Mastercard's European cyber + intelligence centre — fraud, threat intel, payment security.
notes: Major cybersecurity employer in Dublin. Hires analysts + engineers in fraud, threat intel, security operations. Strong CSEP pipeline.

name: Forcepoint (Cork)
what_they_do: Data security and SASE platform — DLP, user behaviour analytics, cloud security.
notes: Cork-based EMEA HQ for Forcepoint. Hires engineers, threat researchers, SOC. Sponsors regularly.

name: Akamai (Dublin)
what_they_do: CDN + edge security — bot management, WAF, DDoS protection, zero trust.
notes: Akamai's EMEA headquarters. Strong security engineering teams in Dublin. Sponsors CSEP regularly.

name: Proofpoint (Belfast / Cork)
what_they_do: Email + people-centric security platform — anti-phishing, DLP, threat intelligence.
notes: Significant engineering + threat research presence in Belfast and Cork. SOC + threat intel + engineering roles. Sponsors.

name: IBM Security (Dublin)
what_they_do: Enterprise security — QRadar SIEM, X-Force threat intel, identity, data security.
notes: Large IBM cybersecurity presence in Ireland. SOC + security engineering + consulting roles. Established sponsor pipeline.

name: Cisco (Dublin)
what_they_do: Network security, Talos threat intelligence, Duo MFA, Umbrella DNS security.
notes: Cisco's substantial Dublin + Galway engineering presence includes security teams. Talos threat intel work happens here. Sponsors.

name: Okta (Dublin)
what_they_do: Identity + access management platform — workforce + customer identity, SSO, MFA.
notes: Okta's EMEA HQ in Dublin. Strong identity-security engineering presence. Sponsors.

name: Cygilant
what_they_do: Managed detection and response (MDR) for mid-market enterprises.
notes: MDR provider with Dublin + Belfast SOC. Hires L1/L2 SOC analysts — strong fit for entry/associate.

name: Novatra Cybersecurity
what_they_do: Cybersecurity advisory + virtual CISO services for SMEs and scale-ups.
notes: Newer Irish cybersecurity boutique. Limited hiring at scale. Worth tracking for graduate / first-job opportunities.

name: Stryker (Limerick / Cork)
what_they_do: Medical device manufacturer — significant product security + IoT security team in Ireland.
notes: Niche but interesting — medical device security is a growing field. Stryker's Irish ops include product security roles.

name: Keeper Security (Dublin)
what_they_do: Password management, secrets management, privileged access for enterprise.
notes: Smaller multinational with growing Dublin presence. Engineering + customer security roles.

name: Mandiant (Google Cloud) Dublin
what_they_do: Incident response, red team, threat intelligence — part of Google Cloud Security since 2022.
notes: Mandiant's Dublin office hires IR + red team + threat hunters. Sponsors via Google's CSEP pipeline. Strongest brand on a CV for offensive/IR work.

name: Rapid7 (Belfast)
what_they_do: Vulnerability management (InsightVM), SIEM (InsightIDR), AppSec, attack surface management.
notes: Major engineering R&D centre in Belfast. Hires AppSec, detection engineers, threat researchers. UK visa rules apply for Belfast roles.
